claim_text: Planzer says cybercriminals stole data on its customers' transport orders
summary: The Swiss logistics company Planzer says it was hit by a cyberattack in which data on customers' transport orders was taken: shipment data sent to it through its interfaces or its customer portal.
detail: Planzer's own notice could not be read by the desk; its words come from outlets that quote it.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Netzwoche quotes Planzer: affected are "Sendungsdaten, die uns über Schnittstellen oder über unser Kundenportal übermittelt wurden"; Inside IT: Planzer said data on customers' transport orders was stolen; AWP reports the same.

claim_text: Names, addresses and contact details on all Planzer Paket parcels from Jan 2018 to Feb 2023 were taken
summary: Planzer's head of communications told the AWP news agency that, as far as is known, data on every parcel sent with Planzer Paket from Jan 1, 2018, to Feb 26, 2023, is affected: senders' and recipients' names, addresses and contact details.
detail: Planzer gave no number of customers or shipments.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: AWP: "die Sendungsdaten aller Pakete betroffen, die vom 1. Januar 2018 bis und mit 26. Februar 2023 mit Planzer Paket verschickt wurden"; stolen data includes "Namen, Adressen und Kontaktangaben von Absendern und Empfängern".

claim_text: Logins to Planzer's customer portal for shippers were taken in encrypted form and have been reset
summary: Planzer says login details for its customer portal, used by businesses that send parcels, were stolen in encrypted form. It deactivated them as a precaution, and users had to set a new password.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Netzwoche and Inside IT: Zugangsdaten zum Kundenportal were taken "in verschlüsselter Form"; AWP: Planzer "habe diese vorsorglich deaktiviert" and users had to set a new password.

claim_text: Planzer says payment and financial data and parcel recipients' portal logins were not affected
summary: Planzer says logins to its separate portal for parcel recipients and payment and financial data were not affected. It told AWP that pharmaceutical transport and warehouse data were not affected either.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Netzwoche: not affected "Zugangsdaten zu seinem Paket-Empfängerportal sowie Zahlungs- und Finanzdaten"; Inside IT says the same; AWP adds pharma transport and warehouse logistics data.

claim_text: Planzer found it through unusual activity in its systems, and has not said when it began
summary: Planzer says the attack was discovered through unusual activity in its IT systems. It has not said when the unauthorised access began or when it noticed it, citing the ongoing investigation.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Inside IT: discovered "wegen ungewöhnlicher Aktivitäten in den IT-Systemen"; AWP: the spokesperson left open when the access began and when Planzer noticed it, citing the ongoing investigation.

claim_text: Planzer has told Switzerland's cybersecurity office and data protection commissioner, and is going to the police
summary: Planzer says internal and external IT forensic specialists are investigating. It has informed the Federal Office for Cybersecurity (BACS) and the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner, and is filing a criminal complaint.
detail: Netzwoche says the complaint has been filed; AWP and Inside IT say Planzer announced it would file one.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Netzwoche: Planzer "informierte das Bundesamt für Cybersicherheit (BACS) sowie den Eidgenössischen Datenschutz- und Öffentlichkeitsbeauftragten (EDÖB) und erstattete Strafanzeige"; Inside IT and AWP: it will file a complaint.

claim_text: Digitec Galaxus says data on its customers' orders was taken, the newest from early 2023
summary: Digitec Galaxus, a Planzer customer, says data on Digitec and Galaxus orders was taken in the attack: parcel numbers, names, delivery addresses, email addresses and sometimes phone numbers. The newest dates from early 2023.
detail: AWP says Digitec Galaxus told customers on Wednesday Nov 25.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Netzwoche quotes Digitec Galaxus: "Paketnummern, Namen, Lieferadressen, E-Mail-Adressen und teilweise Telefonnummern", the newest from early 2023; Inside IT and AWP report the same.

claim_text: Digitec Galaxus says its own systems were not affected and it is keeping Planzer as a carrier
summary: Digitec Galaxus says its own systems were not hit and the customer and payment data stored on its platforms are safe. It is keeping Planzer as a delivery provider.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Inside IT: "die Systeme von Digitec und Galaxus von dem Cyberangriff nicht betroffen" and both "hielten an Planzer als Lieferdienstleister fest"; Netzwoche: its own systems were not affected.

claim_text: Brack.ch says it works with Planzer but was not affected
summary: The online retailer Brack.ch told AWP it was not affected. It uses Planzer for freight, which Planzer says was not affected, and found no data from its earlier same-day deliveries with Quickpac, which Planzer took over in 2024.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: AWP: Brack.ch "war vom Hackerangriff nicht betroffen"; it works with Planzer on freight shipments, which "laut Planzer vom Datendiebstahl nicht betroffen" are; no shipment data from the Quickpac work was affected.

claim_text: Planzer has not said how many customers or shipments are affected
summary: Planzer has given no number of customers or shipments affected, and it is not known whether other business customers besides Digitec Galaxus are affected.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: AWP: the spokesperson gave no number of affected customers or shipments ("machte ... keine Angaben"), and "Ob und wie viele weitere Kundenunternehmen betroffen sind, bleibt offen."

claim_text: Nobody has been named as behind the attack
summary: Planzer and the outlets that reported the attack name no person or group behind it, and no group has been reported claiming it.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: AWP, Netzwoche and Inside IT refer only to hackers or cybercriminals and name no attacker or claim of responsibility.

claim_text: Planzer is still delivering parcels as usual
summary: AWP reports that Planzer is still delivering orders as usual.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: AWP: "Planzer liefere Bestellungen weiterhin wie gewohnt aus."

claim_text: Planzer and Digitec Galaxus warn that the data could be used for convincing phishing
summary: Both companies warn that criminals could use the stolen data to write convincing fake messages. Digitec Galaxus advises strong, different passwords for each site and not clicking links in suspicious emails.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Netzwoche: "Sowohl Planzer als auch Digitec Galaxus warnen in ihren Mitteilungen vor Missbrauch der abgeflossenen Daten" and Digitec Galaxus advises strong passwords and not clicking links in suspicious emails.

claim_text: Planzer is a family-owned Swiss transport and logistics company
summary: Planzer is a Swiss transport and logistics company based in Seewen, Schwyz, with its operational headquarters in Dietikon near Zurich. It is owned by the Planzer family.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Wikipedia: Planzer "is a Swiss transportation and logistics company based in Seewen, Schwyz"; operational headquarters in Dietikon; "entirely owned and controlled by the extended Planzer family".
